title: A Novel Auditory Application for Distraction in Pediatric Patients
official: A Novel Auditory Application for Distraction in Pediatric Patients: A Pilot Feasibility and Acceptability Study
summary: This mixed-methods study seeks to evaluate the feasibility of Mystic Pets software and hardware within the pediatric population. This study will take place at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital (Stanford University, Palo Alto, CA).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Between 4-17 years
* English speaking participants

Exclusion Criteria:

* Legal guardian not present to obtain consent
* Child with hearing impairment
* Child with a significant neurological condition, or major developmental disability
* Child with facial abnormalities or injuries prohibiting use of headsets
* Nausea at the time of recruitment,
* A history of severe motion sickness,
* A history of seizures
